name: Haskell
typeSystem: Static, strong, inferred (Hindley-Milner), type classes, lazy evaluation
runtime: Compiled to native (GHC), with RTS providing GC and green threads
concurrencyModel: Lightweight green threads (forkIO), STM (Software Transactional Memory), sparks for parallelism

codeExample.source:
module Main where

fib :: Int -> Int
fib 0 = 0
fib 1 = 1
fib n = fib (n - 1) + fib (n - 2)

main :: IO ()
main = mapM_ (print . fib) [0..9]
